irs_estate.title: Estate tax (filing thresholds, gross estate, portability)
irs_estate.supports: Filing threshold by year of death, 2011-2026 ($15,000,000 for 2026). Gross estate includes cash, securities, real estate, insurance and trusts. Portability must be elected on a timely filed Form 706.

irs_2027.title: News release IR-2026-133: inflation adjustments for tax year 2027
irs_2027.supports: 2027 basic exclusion $15,480,000; annual gift exclusion $20,000 (2027) and $19,000 (2026); top income-tax rate 37%.

usc_2001.title: 26 U.S.C. 2001 - estate tax rate schedule
usc_2001.supports: Taxable amounts over $1,000,000: $345,800 plus 40% of the excess.

irs_basis.title: FAQ: gifts and inheritances (basis of inherited property)
irs_basis.supports: Basis of inherited property is generally its fair market value at the date of death (or the alternate valuation date if elected).

irs_409.title: Topic no. 409, Capital gains and losses
irs_409.supports: Long-term rates 0%, 15%, 20%; unrecaptured section 1250 gain up to 25%; inherited property is treated as held long term.

irs_559.title: Topic no. 559, Net investment income tax
irs_559.supports: 3.8% on the lesser of net investment income or income above $200,000 (single) / $250,000 (joint); rents and real-estate gains count.

irs_701.title: Topic no. 701, Sale of your home
irs_701.supports: Exclude up to $250,000 ($500,000 joint) of gain if owned and used as main home for 24 months of the 5 years before sale.

irs_414.title: Topic no. 414, Rental income and expenses
irs_414.supports: Rent is taxable income; expenses and depreciation are deductible; rental profit may be subject to the net investment income tax.

irs_ira.title: Retirement topics - Beneficiary
irs_ira.supports: A designated beneficiary who is not an eligible designated beneficiary must empty an inherited account by the end of the 10th year after the owner's death.

irs_1041.title: File an estate tax income tax return (Form 1041)
irs_1041.supports: Form 1041 is required if the estate generates more than $600 of annual gross income; an EIN is needed; due April 15 for calendar-year filers.

irs_i706.title: Instructions for Form 706
irs_i706.supports: Form 706 is due within 9 months after the date of death; automatic 6-month extension by Form 4768.

irs_p527.title: Publication 527, Residential Rental Property
irs_p527.supports: Residential rental buildings are depreciated straight-line over 27.5 years.

irs_rr2023.title: Revenue Ruling 2023-2
irs_rr2023.supports: No basis adjustment at death for assets of an irrevocable grantor trust that are not included in the gross estate.

sco.title: Estate tax
sco.supports: No California estate tax return is required for deaths on or after 1 January 2005; inheritance tax applies only to deaths before 8 June 1982.

ftb_inh.title: Gifts and inheritance
ftb_inh.supports: An inheritance is not income; later income from it (rent, interest, gain on sale) is taxable.

ftb_cg.title: Capital gains and losses
ftb_cg.supports: California has no lower rate for capital gains; all capital gains are taxed as ordinary income.

ftb_rates.title: Tax News, October 2025 - 2025 tax rate schedules
ftb_rates.supports: 2025 California brackets: 9.3% starts at $72,724 (single) / $145,448 (joint); top listed rate 12.3%.

rtc_13301.title: Revenue and Taxation Code 13301
rtc_13301.supports: Neither the state nor any political subdivision may impose a gift, inheritance, succession, legacy, income or estate tax by reason of a death (added by initiative, 8 June 1982).

rtc_480.title: Revenue and Taxation Code 480
rtc_480.supports: For a transfer at death through a trust, the trustee or transferee files a change in ownership statement within 150 days after the date of death; penalty of $100 or 10% of the tax if not filed within 90 days of the assessor's written request.

rtc_11911.title: Revenue and Taxation Code 11911
rtc_11911.supports: County documentary transfer tax of 55 cents per $500 of value on a sale; a city may levy half that rate, credited against the county tax.

prob_16061.title: Probate Code 16061.7
prob_16061.supports: When a revocable trust becomes irrevocable at a settlor's death, the trustee must serve a notification on beneficiaries and heirs within 60 days.

boe_p19.title: Proposition 19
boe_p19.supports: Parent-child exclusion applies only to a family home that was the parent's principal residence and becomes the child's; excluded amount is taxable value plus $1 million (adjusted every two years); homeowners' exemption within 1 year; claim within 3 years or before a sale to a third party.

boe_cap.title: Letter to Assessors 2025/009 - Proposition 19 adjusted amount
boe_cap.supports: $1,044,586 for 16 February 2025 through 15 February 2027; next adjustment in February 2027 by the FHFA California house price index.

boe_guid.title: Letter to Assessors 2026/026 - Proposition 19 questions and answers
boe_guid.supports: Value above factored base year value plus the cap is added to the taxable value; in a multi-unit building only the parent's own unit qualifies; the child must move in within one year; moving out removes the exclusion.

boe_infl.title: Letter to Assessors 2024/053 - inflation factors 1976-2025
boe_infl.supports: Annual base-year-value factor is the California CPI change, capped at 2% (factor 1.02 in most years; lower in 2010-11, 2011-12, 2014-15, 2015-16, 2016-17 and 2021-22).

boe_infl26.title: Letter to Assessors 2026/002 - 2026-27 inflation factor
boe_infl26.supports: Assessors to prepare the 2026 roll using an inflation factor of 1.02.

boe_hoe.title: Homeowners' exemption
boe_hoe.supports: $7,000 reduction in taxable value for an owner-occupied principal residence; one-time claim on form BOE-266; file by 15 February for the full exemption.

boe_forms.title: Letter to Assessors 2021/007 - Proposition 19 claim forms
boe_forms.supports: Form BOE-19-P is the claim for the parent-child exclusion for transfers on or after 16 February 2021.

coa_rates.publisher: County A (property-tax authority for Property A)
coa_rates.title: Compilation of tax rates and information, fiscal year 2025-26
coa_rates.supports: Rate per $100 of value for each levy; rates differ by tax rate area; value rises by California CPI up to 2% a year; installments delinquent after 10 December and 10 April (10% penalty); supplemental bills follow a change in ownership.

cityb_tax.publisher: City B Treasurer and Tax Collector (authority for Property B)
cityb_tax.title: Secured property taxes
cityb_tax.supports: Secured rate for fiscal year 2026-27 is 1.18162182%; bill = net assessed value x rate + direct charges and special assessments; delinquent after 10 December and 10 April; supplemental assessment after a change in ownership.

cityb_rent.title: Annual allowable rent increase, 1 March 2026 to 28 February 2027
cityb_rent.supports: 1.6% for rent-controlled units (1.4% the year before).

cityb_rentlearn.title: Rent increases (rules, formula and pending legislation)
cityb_rentlearn.supports: One increase every 12 months; amount is 60% of the regional CPI-U increase; no limit on the first rent for a vacant unit; a rent increase licence is required; pending Board of Supervisors File No. 261020 (not enacted) would cap combined banked and capital-improvement increases at 10% a year.

cityb_laws.title: Which units have rent control and eviction protection
cityb_laws.supports: Many units built on or before 13 June 1979 have rent control and eviction protection; an owner move-in is a just cause for eviction.

cdi_tool.title: Homeowners insurance comparison tool (2026)
cdi_tool.supports: Annual premium survey for hypothetical homes by location; not quotes; wildfire surcharges of 15% to over 300% are not reflected.

cdi_guide.title: Residential insurance guide: homeowners and renters
cdi_guide.supports: What a homeowners policy covers (dwelling, other structures, personal property, loss of use, liability); advice to compare price, coverage and conditions.

cpuc_nem.title: Net energy metering and net billing
cpuc_nem.supports: NEM tariffs are closed to new enrolment; applicants since 15 April 2023 take the net billing tariff, whose export credits are usually below the retail rate. Two distinct legacy periods are confirmed on the page: NEM 2.0 customers may remain on that tariff for 20 years from interconnection (D.14-03-041), while the NBT legacy period is nine years for the original interconnecting customer.

cpuc_water.title: Water (regulated water utilities)
cpuc_water.supports: Regulator of investor-owned water utilities and their rate changes; no rate was taken from this page.

sos_memo.title: County Clerk/Registrar of Voters Memorandum 26138 (18 May 2026)
sos_memo.supports: Initiative 1994, 'Repeals voter-enacted changes to property tax rules for transfers between family members', failed: signatures filed were below the number required.

congress_s587.title: S.587 - Death Tax Repeal Act of 2025
congress_s587.supports: Introduced 13 February 2025; read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance; status: introduced.

congress_hr1301.title: H.R.1301 - Death Tax Repeal Act
congress_hr1301.supports: Introduced 13 February 2025; referred to the Committee on Ways and Means.

fomc.title: Statement on longer-run goals and monetary policy strategy (reaffirmed 27 January 2026)
fomc.supports: Longer-run inflation goal of 2 percent (personal consumption expenditures price index).

fred_hpi.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), data from the Federal Housing Finance Agency
fred_hpi.title: All-Transactions House Price Index for California
fred_hpi.supports: Quarterly index (1980 Q1 = 100): 41.65 in 1975 Q1; 200.89 in 1996 Q2; 643.96 in 2006 Q2; 553.43 in 2016 Q2; 966.27 in 2025 Q2; 974.97 in 2026 Q2. Peaks and low points: 229.96 in 1990 Q3, 199.59 in 1995 Q1, 646.07 in 2006 Q3, 380.93 in 2012 Q1. Every second-quarter value from 1975 to 2026 is used in the uneven-economy test.

treasury.title: Daily Treasury par yield curve rates, November 2026

fred_gs10.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), data from the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
fred_gs10.title: Market yield on U.S. Treasury securities at 10-year constant maturity, monthly (H.15 release)
fred_gs10.supports: Monthly averages from April 1953 to October 2026. June readings used for 1975 to 2025: highest 14.30% (1982), lowest 0.73% (2020); 7.86% in 1975, 5.11% in 2006, 1.62% in 2012, 4.38% in 2025.

fred_cpi.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
fred_cpi.title: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers, all items, U.S. city average, annual averages

hud_fmr.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
hud_fmr.title: Fair Market Rents dataset
hud_fmr.supports: Official place to look up benchmark rents by area and bedroom count; the page could not be opened in this review, so no rent was taken from it.

gh_prs.title: Pull requests
gh_prs.supports: Merge history and open pull requests of the parallel sessions.

irs_rp2635.title: Revenue Procedure 2026-35, section 3.44 (2027 inflation-adjusted items)
irs_rp2635.supports: Section 3.44: for calendar year 2027 the basic exclusion amount under IRC 2010(c)(3) is $15,480,000; section 3.46(1) sets the 2027 annual gift exclusion at $20,000.

irs_rp2532.title: Revenue Procedure 2025-32 (2026 inflation-adjusted items)
irs_rp2532.supports: The 2025 reconciliation act set the basic exclusion amount at $15,000,000 for calendar year 2026 and indexes it for inflation from 2027. Official text seen as a search excerpt only.

irs_706.title: Instructions for Form 706 (rev. July 2026)
irs_706.supports: For decedents dying in 2026 the basic exclusion amount is $15,000,000 and the applicable credit amount is $5,945,800. Official text seen as a search excerpt only.

boe_pub29.title: California Property Tax: An Overview (Publication 29, March 2025)
boe_pub29.supports: Proposition 13 limits the rate to 1 percent plus voter-approved bonded indebtedness, caps annual increases in base year value at 2 percent, and reassesses to market value only on a change of ownership or new construction.

boe_p19_fact.title: Proposition 19 fact sheet: intergenerational transfer exclusion
boe_p19_fact.supports: The transferee must live in the family home as a principal residence and file for the homeowners' exemption within one year; the value limit is the factored base year value plus $1,000,000 adjusted every other year; form BOE-19-P is the claim. Official text seen as a search excerpt only.

cdi_report.title: Residential Property Insurance Report, Part I 2008-2023 and Part II ZIP-level 2018-2023
cdi_report.supports: Part I publishes written premiums, exposures and average written premiums by policy form; Part II publishes ZIP-code level earned premiums and coverage amounts. The department's comparison tool publishes survey premiums for hypothetical homes, not quotes. ZIP-level figures are not reproduced here.

cdi_avg2017.title: Homeowners Multi-Peril Data 2001-2017 (archived Part I table)
cdi_avg2017.supports: Statewide average written premium for owner-occupied homeowners multiple-peril policies: $620 in 2001 and $1,074 in 2017. A statewide average, not a quote for either property.

bls_100.title: One hundred years of price change: the CPI and the American inflation experience
bls_100.supports: All-items CPI rose 3.5 percent a year in 1913-1929, fell at an annualized 8.3 percent from December 1929 to June 1933, rose 186.4 percent (7.3 percent a year) in 1968-1983 and 133.9 percent (2.9 percent a year) in the later long boom.

bls_2022.title: Consumer prices up 9.1 percent over the year ended June 2022
bls_2022.supports: CPI-U rose 9.1 percent in the 12 months to June 2022, the largest rise since November 1981; electricity rose 13.7 percent in the same period.

frh_inflation.title: The Great Inflation (1965-1982)
frh_inflation.supports: Inflation was a little over 1 percent in 1964 and reached more than 14 percent in 1980, then averaged 3.5 percent in the latter half of the 1980s; the episode included four recessions and two severe energy shortages.

cbo_2026.title: The Budget and Economic Outlook: 2026 to 2036 (February 2026)
cbo_2026.supports: PCE inflation slows from 2.8 percent in 2025 to 2.7 percent in 2026 and returns to roughly the Federal Reserve's 2 percent goal in 2030; the 10-year Treasury rate rises gradually through 2027.

ssa_2026.title: 2026 OASDI Trustees Report: assumptions about the future
ssa_2026.supports: For the last 65 projection years the annual CPI-W change is 2.4 percent (intermediate), 3.0 percent (low-cost) and 1.8 percent (high-cost); the ultimate real interest rate is 2.3 percent for 2044 and later.

tsp_returns.title: Rates of return (official fund performance)
tsp_returns.supports: For the year 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026: C Fund (S&P 500 index) 12.09 percent, G Fund 4.61 percent. Historical returns, not a forecast.

sos_2026.title: State ballot measures, 3 November 2026 general election (unofficial results)
sos_2026.supports: Unofficial statewide results posted 10 November 2026, certification due 11 December 2026. No measure repealing the family-transfer property tax rules appears; Proposition 42 passed with 51.5 percent; Proposition 40 failed with 47.4 percent.
